name: Lavender
summary: EWL/DTL edge of Kallang–Jalan Besar — older condo and walk-up stock, food density toward Jalan Besar, and shorter CBD hops than far-east towns.
body: Lavender is the shortlist when East-West / Downtown Line access and Jalan Besar food matter more than polished mall living. Housing mixes older condos, walk-ups, and estate edges toward Kallang; nightlife and late-kitchen energy spill from the Jalan Besar / Bendemeer fringe. Expats land here for CBD-adjacent rents and MRT optionality rather than quiet cul-de-sac defaults. Compare with Bugis for denser retail/tourism gravity, Farrer Park for a slightly more residential north-of-Rochor feel, and Kallang when stadium event spillover is the trade you are actually buying.
bestFor: CBD-adjacent workers who want older-stock rents
condo renters who will vet MA reno / lift rules
car-light couples testing city-fringe before RV prices
watchOuts: Fewer quiet-heartland defaults than upstream NEL towns
housingMix: Older condo and walk-up stock with estate edges toward Kallang.
commuteNotes: East-West and Downtown Line at Lavender; test a Friday 19:30 door-to-desk and the walk toward Jalan Besar in rain.
